name: college-roi-mcp
description: U.S. college ROI data: 30-year NPV for 500 colleges, lifetime ROI for 134 majors, best-value and out-of-state-penalty rankings. Free, keyless, CC BY 4.0.
long_description: 30-year NPV for 500 U.S. four-year colleges (resident & non-resident), lifetime ROI for 19 major categories + 115 CIP subfields, per-state best-value rankings, and the out-of-state tuition penalty. Wraps the free, keyless LE TEEN College ROI API (CC BY 4.0, FREOPP/IPEDS/BEA-derived, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21351602).

tools.name: get_api_info
tools.description: Metadata for the underlying LE TEEN College ROI API: description, license, attribution, DOI, docs URL, and the list of raw endpoints.

tools.name: list_majors
tools.description: List bachelor's-degree majors (19 broad categories and/or 115 CIP subfields) with lifetime-ROI stats: median/mean lifetime ROI (USD), share of graduates in programs that never break even, median break-even age among programs that break even, and AI-exposure band (category rows only). Returns compact rows sorted by the chosen field. Use the returned slug with get_major for full detail.

kind.description: Filter to broad categories (19), CIP subfields (115), or all 134.

parent.description: Only subfields of this category slug, e.g. 'engineering'.

sort_by.description: Sort field. ROI sorts are descending; name ascending.

tools.name: get_major
tools.description: Full lifetime-ROI record for one major category or CIP subfield by slug (e.g. 'nursing', 'computer-science', 'philosophy-and-religious-studies'): ROI distribution (p25/median/mean/p75), never-break-even %, break-even age, completion-adjusted and dropout ROI, graduates/programs counts, and AI-exposure detail. Accepts a plain name and will slugify it; use list_majors to discover exact slugs.

slug.description: Major slug or name, e.g. 'computer-science' or 'Computer Science'.

tools.name: search_colleges
tools.description: Search the 500 largest-coverage U.S. four-year colleges that clear the positive-NPV envelope. Each row: 30-year NPV at resident and non-resident pricing, total cost of attendance, median earnings 10 years after entry, and break-even age. Filter by name substring, state, and control; sorted by resident NPV descending unless overridden. Use the returned slug with get_college.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring of the college name.

tools.name: get_college
tools.description: Full record for one college by slug (e.g. 'university-of-michigan-ann-arbor'): 30-year NPV at resident and non-resident pricing, total cost of attendance both ways, median earnings 10 years after entry, break-even age, IPEDS unitid, and FREOPP program coverage. Accepts a plain name and will slugify it; use search_colleges to discover slugs.

tools.name: best_value_colleges
tools.description: Each U.S. state's best-value four-year colleges at resident pricing, ranked by 30-year NPV (top 15 per state). Pass a state for its full list; omit it for a nationwide summary (every state's top pick).

state.description: Two-letter state code, e.g. 'CA'. Omit for all states' #1.

tools.name: out_of_state_penalty
tools.description: U.S. public four-year colleges ranked by the out-of-state penalty: how much 30-year NPV a non-resident gives up versus a resident at the same school. Includes both NPVs and both tuition figures per row.

state.description: Filter to one state's public colleges.
